notes.title: Build v1.2 Animations, Custom Background Tracks....
notes.content:
We’ve been working hard to improve your drumming experience, and here’s what’s new in the latest build:

🎵 New Features
Import Custom Soundtracks:

Run the game if you haven’t already, and a CustomSoundTracks folder will be automatically generated.
Navigate to the game’s executable directory and drop your sound files into the new folder.
Restart the game and jam along with your favorite tracks!
Camera Options:
Added 3 new camera views to enhance your perspective and immersion.

Improved Animations:

Kick pedal now features proper animation.
Cymbals and hi-hat have been given realistic motion for a better visual experience.
🚀 Upcoming Update Highlights
Here’s what’s on the horizon:

AI Band Members to accompany you during performances.
Concert Stage with a lively crowd to amp up the energy!
Audio Effects to simulate an authentic live concert environment.
A Control System for Drum Intensity for dynamic and expressive drumming.
Thank you for your support—keep rocking, and we’ll see you on the stage!

notes.title: Drumming Reinvented – A New Sandbox for Beat Creators!
notes.content:
Hello Drummers! 🎸🥁

I’m thrilled to share that Drumming Simulator is getting an overhaul, launching this Friday. Expect a hands-on, unpolished drumming sandbox that’s as functional as it is fun—and it’s all built by me! This update adds key features designed for pure, customizable drumming:

🎶 Pattern Builder – Create your own beat patterns, adjust the BPM, and get into your rhythm, your way.
🥁 Dynamic Drum Animations – Watch as each hit comes to life in real-time with animations that feel as satisfying as your beats.
🎵 Play Along to Your Own Tracks – Now, you can bring in your favorite songs, set your patterns, and drum along in sync.

Plus, I’m adding a range of new environments like arenas and stadiums for drummers who want the ultimate stage. These features will only grow from here, but this is your chance to experience drumming like never before.

The price will increase to $15 after this launch, so grab it now if you want the best deal. And for a taste of what’s coming, check out the gif of my latest progress—get ready to feel the rhythm in Drumming Simulator like you’ve never felt before!
